checks.description: Default secondary/medium/before/enabled, rounded with content and circle icon-only; all four appearances, three sizes, three shapes and two icon positions resolve.
Ordinary ref prop receives the native root instance.

tests.name: Button forwards its ref prop to the native root

checks.description: Synthetic hover and press update presentation and forward caller callbacks exactly once.

tests.name: Button forwards press and interaction handlers while updating visual state

checks.description: Supported Pressable props and native ref compile; owned children/style behavior and optional slots retain the public API.
Only supplied optional slots render, with focus visual first and active icon before/after content according to iconPosition; selectedIcon falls back to icon.
selected=false retains regular icon and omits selectedIcon.

tests.name: Button uses the regular icon while a toggle button is not selected

checks.description: Constrained content wraps instead of truncating; icon-only layout remains at least 24 by 24 through all sizes/shapes.
Each appearance resolves rest/selected/disabled/hover/pressed foreground, background and border; disabled overrides interaction and pressed overrides hover, including selected-disabled combinations.
Small/medium/large match radius/padding/gap, bodySmall/Medium/Large typography and 16/20/20 icons; square/circle override radius and user style wins last.
Disabled root is unfocusable, reports disabled and blocks synthetic press while using disabled secondary background.

tests.name: Button disables interaction and exposes disabled accessibility state

checks.description: Review all appearance/size/shape and selected/disabled/hover/pressed combinations on native renderers, including wrapping and icon-only target geometry.
Plain strings/numbers and slot children supply names; native/ARIA explicit labels and references win, including empty native labels; rich content requires caller naming.
Unnamed icon-only button emits the action-oriented naming warning.

tests.name: Button warns when an icon-only button has no accessible name

checks.description: Root is one accessible button, caller busy state survives owned disabled/checked values, both icon sources are decorative.
Review UIA/AX name, role and enabled state, plus Windows toggle announcements; do not infer macOS checked projection from rendered labels.
Selected true exposes checked state, replaces regular icon and renders invisible semibold reservation beneath visible semibold text.

tests.name: Button uses selected semantics, selected icon, and a ghost label to prevent reflow

checks.description: selected absent versus false versus true distinguishes checked semantics; press never mutates selection; Toggle declaration retains caller labels/actions and owned checked overrides aria-checked.
Actual Win32 Toggle dispatch forwards the unchanged event without synthesizing press; owner updates selection; Windows UIA checked state follows supplied value.
Toggling selected leaves native label/button width stable with wrapping, scaled text and both icon positions.

Windows/macOS system ring has no custom subtree; Win32 persistent dual ring is self-focus/keyboard-modality gated, disabled-hidden, radius preserving and noninteractive; explicit custom/alwaysVisible options preserve focus requirement.
Physical Tab/Shift+Tab skip disabled; Return/Space activate exactly once at platform phase; held/repeated/overlapping keys, blur and disable clear feedback without stale activation.
Native-confirmed ref focus rejects detached/disabled targets, distinguishes self from descendants, preserves modality across nested themes and same-target pointer/keyboard transitions.
Review native system and custom dual-ring appearance without treating modality counters as pixels.

limitations: macOS AXButton checked reads are unsupported by the pinned renderer/provider; Toggle there is a custom action, not AXPress.
Win32 intervening-key onPressOut has a documented temporary gap (#4373); no complete keyboard qualification is claimed.
Unit presses do not prove physical activation or accessibility action transport. Native, visual and screen-reader records remain unlinked.
